text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Public Environment Authority launches new environment awareness campaign on July 13.
- Labour unions of government workers call for solutions for unemployment among Kuwaitis.
- Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development extended a loan to finance a number of development projects in Bosnia.
- Kuwait's interior ministry halts residence permits for holders of passports from Bolivia and El Salvador after discovering a number of forged travel documents presented by stateless residents.
- Ministry of social affairs and labour completes draft of new labour law.
- Education and Higher Education Minister Abdulla al-Ghunaim says Kuwait will not hire Jordanian teachers.
- Interior Ministry plans to expand central prison.
